product.title: Marco Island 2 hour Dolphin, Birding and Shelling tour

description.text: Discover some of coastal Florida's loveliest scenery, and its wealth of wildlife, on this small-group tour of the Ten Thousand Islands National Wildlife Refuge from Marco Island. Pick from several daily departure times, and set off with just a small group for company. Go on a naturalist-guided boat tour to spot animals like dolphins, pelicans, spoonbills, manatees, sea turtles, and more. Ideal for Naples and Marco Island visitors who want shallow-water shelling, dolphin watching, and mangrove-lined routes without chartering a boat alone.
